description:
The TEO Teams upgrades to TE8 Teams!

Join us with your friends to fight in this 3-day, 8-player/team, 5-round Warhammer 40,000 event with a player capacity of 20 teams. Rounds will be 4:00 in length. Chess clocks will be present at every table.

This event has 16 Golden Tickets available for the World Championship of Warhammer!

Every team will receive a 12ft Custom banner for their team + a 6x4ft Flag and custom pairing cards!

You can download the Player's Packet 

WHERE IT IS: The event will occur at the Planters Bank-Jennie Stuart Health Sportsplex of Hopkinsville, a 60,000 sq ft building.

Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/2n8Wn8vzHh) to stay up to date!!!!

IMPORTANT DATES

++October 8th++ - Rules and Points Cutoff

++October 9th by 8:00 PM CST++ - Model/Proxy Submission Deadline

++October 10th by 8:00 PM CST++ - Lists Submitted

++October 16th - Event Start++

++October 18th - Event End++

ARMY SELECTION

Each player’s army should muster rules for Strike Force missions using the most current sources, rulings, and points.

TERRAIN AND MISSIONS

The Terrain will follow the Games Workshop format using the most current resources. You can also test our terrain on TTS: 

AWARDS:

Best Overall - The Player with the highest composite Hobby and Play Score no warnings for sportsmanship

Best Painted Army - Master of the Forge -  The Judges select the Team with the highest medium hobby score

Best Painted - The Player with the best-painted Model is selected by the Judges.

Best in Faction (multiple) - The highest-ranked player in each faction.

Wooden Spoon - The lowest-ranked player

Team Spirit Award - The team that demonstrated exceptional sporting spirit

Trophies will be allocated to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place.

placingMetrics.name: Match Points
placingMetrics.description: Total match points for the team. 2 match points are awarded for a team winning their match, 1 point is awarded for a tie and 0 for a loss.

placingMetrics.name: Battle Points
placingMetrics.description: The sum total of all Battle Points earned from each player on the team.

placingMetrics.name: Victory Points before Differential
placingMetrics.description: Total Victory Points earned prior to a Victory Point Differential from games submitted. This should only be used when using a Differential Scorecard

placingMetrics.name: Game Wins
placingMetrics.description: Total games won by individual players on the team.

placingMetrics.name: Points Destroyed
placingMetrics.description: The sum total of all Points Destroyed earned from each player on the team.

placingMetrics.name: Match Points SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents' match points, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Wins SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents match win totals, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Game Wins SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents' average game wins per match, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Battle Points SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents' average battle point per match, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Match Points Extended SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Match Points SoS, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Wins Extended SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Wins SoS, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Game Wins Extended SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Game Wins SoS, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Battle Points Extended SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Battle Points SoS, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Swiss Points
placingMetrics.description: 3 points are award for every win the team receives, 1 point for every tie and 0 points for every loss. This is then the total of all those points awarded

placingMetrics.name: Swiss SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Swiss Points, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

placingMetrics.name: Swiss Points Extended SoS
placingMetrics.description: The sum of all of team's opponents Swiss Points SoS, divided by the number of opponents team has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Wins
playerPlacingMetrics.description: Total match wins for a player. Ties are worth 0.5 wins, but recommended you use Swiss Points instead of wins if ties are possible.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Battle Points
playerPlacingMetrics.description: Total points earned from game submitted.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Victory Points before Differential
playerPlacingMetrics.description: Total Victory Points earned prior to a Victory Point Differential from games submitted. This should only be used when using a Differential Scorecard

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Points Destroyed
playerPlacingMetrics.description: Total points of all units completely destroyed across all games.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Wins SoS
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents win totals, divided by the number of opponents player has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Battle Points SoS
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents' average battle point per game, divided by the number of opponents player has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Swiss Points
playerPlacingMetrics.description: 3 points are award for every win the player receives, 1 point for every tie and 0 points for every loss. This is then the total of all those points awarded

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Path to Victory
playerPlacingMetrics.description: Measures a player's win path relative to other players where earlier losses are more impactful than later losses.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Oppt. Game Win %
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The average of all your opponents' game win percentage with a minimum cap of 33%.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Extended Oppt. Game Win %
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The average of all your opponents opponents' game win percentage with a minimum cap of 33%.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Swiss SoS
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents Swiss Points, divided by the number of opponents player has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Margin of Victory
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents Swiss Points, divided by the number of opponents player has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.name: Wins Extended SoS
playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents Wins SoS, divided by the number of opponents player has played.

playerPlacingMetrics.description: The sum of all of player's opponents Battle Points SoS, divided by the number of opponents player has played.
